# Sales Analysis Project

## Overview
This project demonstrates end-to-end **Data Analysis** using:
- Python (Jupyter Notebook) for data cleaning, EDA, and visualizations
- Tableau for interactive dashboards and business insights

Dataset: `train.csv` (Retail Sales Data)

## Steps Performed
1. Data Cleaning (handled missing values, converted dates)
2. Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) in Python
3. Monthly & Yearly Sales Trend
4. Category & Region Analysis
5. Profit & Profit Margin (calculated fields in Tableau)
6. Dashboard creation in Tableau

## Tools Used
- Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn)
- Tableau Public
- Jupyter Notebook

## Insights
- Central region generated the highest profit.
- Technology category had the highest profit margin.
- Seasonal spikes observed in March and December.
- Top customers contributed significantly to overall revenue.
